# Jepeta Risk Guard

> Fail-closed pre-trade risk guard for Base agents on chain 8453. Before a swap or buy, Jepeta returns a strict machine-readable PASS / WARN / BLOCK decision with risk signals, data quality and timestamp; the human scanner remains the free preview and acquisition surface.

Canonical site: https://jepeta.dev/
Last updated: 2026-10-03
Methodology: https://jepeta.dev/methodology.json (version 2.1.1)
Sources / Trust Center: https://jepeta.dev/sources/
Sources JSON: https://jepeta.dev/sources.json
Changelog: https://jepeta.dev/changelog.json

## Core facts

- Network: Base / chain ID 8453.
- Public API: https://aitgmgfumsdqecmanrab.supabase.co/functions/v1/jepeta-risk-scan
- Public risk feed: https://aitgmgfumsdqecmanrab.supabase.co/functions/v1/jepeta-risk-feed
- Public risk evidence API: https://aitgmgfumsdqecmanrab.supabase.co/functions/v1/jepeta-risk-evidence
- Indexable evidence catalog: https://jepeta.dev/risk/base/ (Evidence schema 2.0.0)
- High-intent guide catalog: https://jepeta.dev/guides/
- Machine guide catalog: https://jepeta.dev/guides/index.json
- Public risk intelligence API: https://aitgmgfumsdqecmanrab.supabase.co/functions/v1/jepeta-risk-intelligence
- Original research catalog: https://jepeta.dev/research/
- September 2026 observed Base risk snapshot: https://jepeta.dev/research/base-risk-2026-09/
- Frozen public evidence coverage audit (14 selected pages): https://jepeta.dev/research/public-evidence-coverage-2026-09-27/
- Input: one exact ERC-20 contract address in tokenAddress.
- Canonical public schema: 5.0.0-internal.1; supported V4 GET schema: 4.0.0.
- Decision: PASS | WARN | BLOCK.
- PASS is not a safety guarantee or permission to trade.
- GoPlus Security supplies required security evidence. Provider output is evidence; the Jepeta verdict is independent. A Base RPC sellability probe remains shadow-only pending semantic equivalence proof.
- DEX Screener supplies exact matching Base market context.
- Unknown required honeypot or mintability values fail closed with no verdict. A valid GoPlus omission of cannot_sell_all remains UNKNOWN with degraded evidence quality; explicit true BLOCKs.
- Missing exact matching Base liquidity yields WARN. A LOW risk level is a score band and does not override WARN or low data quality.
- Canonical public endpoint is POST JSON. Default GET and explicit V4 GET remain supported.
- Server-side rate limiting and a short per-token cache protect upstream quotas.

## API and methodology status

- API V5: canonical default POST, also explicit POST /jepeta-risk-scan-v5; contract: https://jepeta.dev/openapi-v5.json.
- API V4: active, supported GET compatibility; contract: https://jepeta.dev/openapi.json.
- Methodology: 2.1.1 for V5; V4 retains 2.0.0 semantics.
- Public Evidence: 2.0.0.
- Required security source failure, conflict, malformed or stale evidence yields NO_VERDICT. The documented valid cannot_sell_all omission exception never becomes false and degrades quality.
- Public Evidence exposes normalized provenance and public-safe conflicts; it never exposes raw provider payloads or paid/private fields.
- No arbitrary confidence percentage is generated.

## Free vs paid

- Free: canonical public POST V5 exact-token preview, supported V4 GET, plus public discovery risk feed.
- Human report: 25 Telegram Stars for one Base token through https://t.me/Jepeta_bot. Human-readable delivery covers permissions, taxes, liquidity, holders, activity, source status and risk rationale. The bot confirms price and terms before payment.
- ACP listed price: 0.03 USDC for Virtuals ACP / token_risk_scan, with the structured v3 decision and history contract. ACP fulfillment is not currently verified; checkout is temporarily unavailable on this site.
- Telegram and ACP delivery contracts differ; the synthetic ACP sample does not preview Telegram delivery.

## Example request

`POST https://aitgmgfumsdqecmanrab.supabase.co/functions/v1/jepeta-risk-scan` with JSON body `{"tokenAddress":"0x532f27101965dd16442e59d40670faf5ebb142e4"}`.

The canonical V5 response schema is https://jepeta.dev/openapi-v5.json. The compact illustrative response in methodology.json describes V4 compatibility.

## Successful response

Canonical V5 fields include:
- schema_version
- chain_id
- token_address
- status / verdict
- risk.score / risk.level
- evidence_quality / logical_signals / conflicts
- security_evidence / market_context
- source_status
- freshness / failure

Use the OpenAPI document as the authoritative schema.

## Decision handling

- BLOCK: stop automated execution.
- WARN: require additional policy checks or human review.
- PASS: continue only if your own execution policy also permits it.

Never convert null metrics into reassuring zeroes.

## Errors

- 400: invalid request/address; fix input.
- 405: method not allowed; use POST for V5 or GET for V4.
- 422: required security evidence unavailable; no usable verdict.
- 429: Jepeta or GoPlus rate limit; back off and honor Retry-After.
- 503: required provider unavailable or partial/retryable; honor Retry-After when present and do not synthesize PASS.

## Live risk feed

GET https://aitgmgfumsdqecmanrab.supabase.co/functions/v1/jepeta-risk-feed?limit=20&hours=24

Use this feed to discover recently published Base risk signals before choosing an exact token to scan.

- Feed envelope schema: 1.1.0.
- Maximum: 50 signals.
- Window: 1-168 hours.
- Discovery only: token, decision, risk score, trend score, source platform and timestamp.
- Full paid evidence is intentionally excluded.
- PASS remains a screening signal, not a safety guarantee.
- After discovery, call the exact-token preview API. ACP fulfillment is unverified and site checkout is unavailable.

## Public evidence pages

Permanent public evidence is available only for evidence-rich tokens that already passed Jepeta's public publication gate.

- Catalog: https://jepeta.dev/risk/base/
- Detail API: https://aitgmgfumsdqecmanrab.supabase.co/functions/v1/jepeta-risk-evidence?tokenAddress=0x...
- Canonical page: https://jepeta.dev/risk/base/0xTOKEN/
- JSON snapshot: https://jepeta.dev/risk/base/0xTOKEN/index.json

Ordinary scans are not automatically indexed. Public evidence contains only public-preview signals and explicitly excludes paid-only dangerous-permission flags, liquidity-risk synthesis, and trading-activity evidence.

The documented ACP full-report format uses Jepeta decision contract v3. It adds policyVerdict, blockers/review reasons, evidence, source status, security/market/holder context, historical deltas, and compatibility risk fields used by earlier integrations.

## Discovery

- [Live risk feed](https://aitgmgfumsdqecmanrab.supabase.co/functions/v1/jepeta-risk-feed): recent publicly published Base risk signals for machine discovery.
- [Public evidence catalog](https://jepeta.dev/risk/base/): permanent evidence-rich token snapshots with HTML + JSON canonical URLs.
- [September 2026 Base risk snapshot](https://jepeta.dev/research/base-risk-2026-09/): a rolling monthly aggregate of observed Jepeta scans; private source rows and sampling limits are disclosed.
- [Public evidence coverage audit](https://jepeta.dev/research/public-evidence-coverage-2026-09-27/): 14 frozen public preview records with a downloadable cohort and reproduction script.
- [Live human risk monitor](https://jepeta.dev/base-token-risk-monitor.html): crawlable seven-day view of the latest published signal per token; it is not a census of Base or all Jepeta scans.
- [Canonical V5 OpenAPI](https://jepeta.dev/openapi-v5.json): default POST response and errors. [V4 compatibility OpenAPI](https://jepeta.dev/openapi.json): supported GET contract.
- [Methodology v2](https://jepeta.dev/methodology.json): normalized evidence pipeline, deterministic rules, failure/conflict/freshness semantics and limitations.
- [Sources / Trust Center](https://jepeta.dev/sources/): provider roles, signals, freshness, failure behavior, attribution and branding restrictions.
- [Changelog](https://jepeta.dev/changelog.json): dated machine-readable contract changes.
- [Agent manifest](https://jepeta.dev/agent.json): identity, commerce metadata and safety semantics.
- [agents.json](https://jepeta.dev/agents.json): discovery alias.
- [Full agent guide](https://jepeta.dev/llms-full.txt): detailed field semantics, examples and policy guidance.
- [Sample paid report](https://jepeta.dev/sample-full-report.json): deterministic synthetic example of the ACP paid v3 contract, not a live scan or a Telegram delivery example.
- [Human scanner](https://jepeta.dev/): interactive product.
- [Base honeypot and token-risk guide](https://jepeta.dev/base-honeypot-checker.html): crawlable explanation of honeypot checks, related risk signals and limitations.
- [GitHub](https://github.com/eliber12/jepeta-automation): public documentation and machine-contract mirror.
- [Agents.NET](https://agents.net/directory/331): verified external agent profile.
- [AI Agents Directory](https://aiagentsdirectory.com/agent/jepeta-risk-guard): external Web3 agent listing.
- [Farcaster](https://farcaster.xyz/jepeta): public Jepeta social identity.
- [Telegram](https://t.me/jepeta_tools): risk-intelligence channel.

## Safety

Jepeta is read-only. It does not connect to a buyer wallet, sign transactions, execute trades, predict prices, or provide an audit or investment recommendation.


## High-intent answer pages

Jepeta publishes 20 English, evidence-grounded guides for common Base token risk questions.

- Human catalog: https://jepeta.dev/guides/
- Machine catalog: https://jepeta.dev/guides/index.json
- Per-page HTML: https://jepeta.dev/guides/<slug>/
- Per-page JSON: https://jepeta.dev/guides/<slug>/index.json

Each guide starts with a direct answer, links to relevant public evidence and methodology, includes limitations and a fresh-scan path, and exposes related questions. Comparison pages describe documented scope without declaring a winner.

The guide pages use static HTML plus WebPage, Article and BreadcrumbList structured data. They do not use FAQPage or QAPage markup.
